context: A rural local introduces a teen to countryside animals
purpose: Teach: イカ/羊/獣/海洋/周波数/計量/結合/生み出す

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: おう、よく来たな。うちの羊、見てくれや。
lines.en: Hey, glad you came. Take a look at our sheep.
lines.style: Warm rural greeting, gravelly and welcoming countryside tone

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: わあ、羊の毛ってこんなにモコモコなんですね！
lines.en: Wow, sheep wool is this fluffy, huh!
lines.style: Bright excited teen voice, slightly high-pitched curiosity bursting out

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: 夜になるとな、裏山から獣の鳴き声が聞こえてくるんだ。
lines.en: At night, you can hear beasts crying from the back mountain.
lines.style: Lower confiding tone, slightly mysterious storytelling rhythm at dusk

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 獣って、たぬきとかですか？ちょっと怖いかも。
lines.en: Beasts, like raccoon dogs? That's kind of scary.
lines.style: Nervous half-laugh, voice rising slightly at the end

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: 海のほうの漁師仲間が、よくイカを分けてくれるんだよ。
lines.en: My fisherman buddies by the sea often share squid with us.
lines.style: Casual proud storytelling, steady warm countryside cadence rolling along

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: イカも貰えるんだ、いいなあ。海洋の生き物って大好きです。
lines.en: You get squid too, that's great. I love marine creatures.
lines.style: Eager teen delight, slightly bookish enthusiasm tumbling out fast

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: 最近の漁船はな、周波数を使ってイカの群れを探すらしいぞ。
lines.en: Lately the boats apparently use frequencies to find squid schools.
lines.style: Impressed warm chuckle then informative grandpa tone sharing news

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 周波数で探すなんて、技術と自然が結合してる感じですごい！
lines.en: Finding them by frequency, tech and nature bonding together, amazing!
lines.style: Animated teen excitement, fast curious pacing with sparkling wonder

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: 捕ったイカはな、港でその場で計量して値段を決めるんだ。
lines.en: The caught squid get weighed right at the port to set the price.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact explanation, hands-on practical tone of a teacher

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: へえ、そうやって新しい仕事のやり方を生み出すんですね。
lines.en: Wow, that's how new ways of working get created, huh.
lines.style: Soft impressed teen reaction, warm closing wonder in voice
